svg.title: build_and_serve and the uvicorn server task
svg.desc: build_and_serve runs three steps in order: build_app registers the routes, init_app_state creates the handlers, and serve_http creates a task for uvicorn Server.serve. Server.serve calls _serve, which runs startup, main_loop and shutdown in order. startup runs the app lifespan startup and then loop.create_server on the bound socket, where asyncio starts listening and gives each connection its own task. main_loop ticks every 0.1 seconds until should_exit is set. Numbers show the call order inside each parent.

g.text: EACH CONNECTION GETS ITS OWN TASK
